# One-Tap Login

As said in [Login with SeaTalk Overview](../../../../../../docs/login-with-seatalk-overview), there are three login methods under Login with SeaTalk. Besides QR-code and Confirm on Phone which requires a mobile phone, One-Tap is provided as a more seamless login method. In this article, we will introduce the user experience under One-Tap and how to turn on this login method for your website.

# One-Tap User Experience

Under One-Tap, when users visit your website, they will tap the Login with SeaTalk button and be redirected to the login confirmation page provided by SeaTalk. The confirmation page has a confirmation button (see the screenshot below for an example). Once users tap "Confirm" and the login is successful, your website will get users' profile information.

The whole user experience is seamless because users will not leave the browser during the whole process.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

# Conditions For One-Tap

To make sure One-Tap works, two conditions have to be met:

1. The user has logged into your website before and there's a valid user login session in the user's browser
2. The One-Tap toggle is turned on for your app

If either of the conditions above is not met, the user will be routed to use the **QR-code** or **Confirm on Phone** login method.

# Turn on One-Tap For Your App

The One-Tap login method is disabled by default. To enable it, go to **App Capability > Login with SeaTalk** in your app's settings. Note that your Organization's Admin approval is required for One-Tap to take effect.

![](data:image/png;base64,)
